title: MR angiography of the head
what: An MRI that shows the blood vessels of the brain. It is often done without contrast dye. No radiation.
why: For a possible aneurysm or narrowed vessels, frequent headaches and dizziness, or after a stroke.
duration: usually 15 to 30 minutes; the report in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: A pacemaker, defibrillator, or other implant with electronics
Metal in your body: joint replacements, plates, clips on blood vessels, or shrapnel
If you are or might be pregnant
If you are afraid of closed spaces. Your doctor will suggest ways to help
Clips on blood vessels after brain surgery. Be sure to mention them

prepare.title: Prep
prepare.text: Usually none without contrast. You can eat and drink.

prepare.title: Contrast
prepare.text: If contrast is ordered, a creatinine test is sometimes needed. Usually no food for 2 to 4 hours. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Metal
prepare.text: Take off everything metal: jewelry, watches, hair clips, piercings. Leave your phone and cards in the locker.

bring: Past head MRIs and CT scans
steps: You change and leave everything metal in the locker
You lie on your back, and your head is placed in a helmet-shaped coil
The machine knocks loudly. You get headphones or earplugs
Lie still. Staff talk to you over an intercom
You hold a call button and can call staff at any time
feel: It does not hurt, but it is loud and tight
Sometimes the area feels warm. That is normal
after: You can go back to your day right away
Take the report to a neurologist
red_flags: A sudden, very severe headache, weakness in an arm or leg, a drooping face, or trouble speaking: call emergency services right away

faq.q: Is contrast needed for the vessels?
faq.a: Often not. The vessels can be seen without it. Sometimes contrast is added, depending on the question.

faq.q: Is it the same as a brain MRI?
faq.a: No. A brain MRI looks at the tissue, and MR angiography looks at the vessels. They are often done together.

reminders.text: Head MRA soon. Take off everything metal and bring past images.
